title: New York Photography Masterclass - Private Photography Lesson
requirements: All areas and surfaces are wheelchair accessible
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
We offer expert guidance: A professional photographer with local knowledge will guide guests to the best locations, angles, and lighting for taking stunning photographs. 

On the tour, guests will receive customised education on camera settings, composition, and other techniques to improve their photography skills. 
As locals, we know the best locations in New York City and can quickly find the best spots to shoot, as well as navigate to some off-the-beaten-path spots for some magical images. Because the tours are private, guests can go at their own pace and be guided with skills to suit their personal level.

Our tours can help participants make the most of their time by maximising the number of photographic opportunities in a short period. Booking with us is a great way to improve your photography skills, explore new locations, and capture unique and stunning photos with expert guidance.
